sections.text: مقدمة

This document out lines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by 
 Y1 in the title block.

The induced fans function: pulling the combustion 
 gases from the furnace through the heat transfer surface in the superheaters, reheaters, economizer, and gases side preheater into the stack.

The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Emad El din Ali, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, revised by 
EDEPC 
inspection & quality control

approved by eng. Mokhter Abd Ellatif; head 
Sector of 
 محطة كهرباء أبو سلطان والمعتمدة من قبل م. علي مصطفى الليثي EDEPC 
 قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة.
